lines.trans: Honestly, advertisers and the television station are simply afraid of risk at bottom.
Once our revamp succeeds, they will all benefit, so they are not impossible to negotiate with.
After the revamp, the ones most uncomfortable will be the signed artists.
Under the old format, their screen time was guaranteed and their fees were high, earning easy money.
After the revamp, however, they will be under mountain-sized pressure.
Not only is the payoff uncertain, it might hurt their reputation and embarrass them in public.
For talent agencies that is downright disastrous; if I were an agent, it would be non-negotiable.

words.gram: Meaning: as far as ... is concerned.

lines.trans: Right now every single talent agency is boycotting it.
If this continues, Twelve Singers will not be able to book anyone and cannot go on.
